# `aitbc edge serve cancel-request`

Cancel a compute request by its ID.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc edge serve cancel-request [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--request-id` | text | — | yes | The Request id. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc edge serve cancel-request --request-id <request_id>
```
